name: medcare-frontend
description: MedCare clinic website - front end. The page code in this folder is plain, readable JavaScript, split by component under js/modules/; this npm project bundles the modern libraries it uses (Motion, Lenis, Swiper, Lucide, Floating UI, auto-animate, dayjs, qrcode, Cropper.js, GSAP) into js/vendor.js so the site stays fully offline.
